scope: Accept sampled motion feedback in the supplied sparse scenario; visual material concerns remain and continuous smoothness is unverified.

coverage.metadataRead: motion.json events, timestamps, camera/player states and particle kinds; no source/keys

hitFlash.evidence: White player at .1/.2s, hull35% to27%, RETURN TO BASE displayed; normal aircraft rendering returns by.4s.

impactRecognition.evidence: Small compact orange blast at.1s and visibly larger irregular bright fireball at1s distinguish event magnitude in both profiles. Large hot core becomes sparse sparks and smoke by1.5s.
impactRecognition.weakness: Half-second post-peak sampling gap cannot show exact expansion curve.

smokeFading.evidence: Smoke trails are translucent and older segments become faint through.4–.6s and1.5–3s. Fire count reaches zero at2s; continued damaged-plane smoke remains. Reduced opacity avoids rock-like high-contrast beads obscuring aircraft.
smokeFading.weakness: Puffs are still discrete and repeated; large-event smoke becomes very faint, though the fireball remains clear.

wakeContinuity.evidence: Carrier and escort wakes stay attached and aligned across sampled positions; escort wake persists at1s,1.5s and2s with no sampled detachment.
wakeContinuity.weakness: Evenly repeated pale puffs resemble a segmented trail more than turbulent water. This is a material-polish concern, not an observed continuity failure.

cameraMotion.evidence: Player recenters during0–.4s, follows the turn through1.5s and stays near a stable screen location thereafter; ship translation agrees with recorded camera/player progression.
cameraMotion.weakness: Initial catch-up remains conspicuous. Sparse samples cannot prove jitter-free motion. Strong diagonal ocean bands introduce a competing directional cue as the aircraft changes heading.

controlVisibility.evidence: Hull/heat, objective, minimap, Bomb and Fire stay anchored and legible through all18frames. Heat rises while firing then falls by3s.
controlVisibility.weakness: World entities can pass behind controls. Keyboard-driven sequence does not verify touch steering.

altitude.evidence: Offset shadows and raised island/hull communicate altitude and volume. Player remains distinguishable in sparse action.
altitude.weakness: Large dark shadow duplicates add clutter and plane still overlaps carrier deck at.4–.6s.

regressionsAndLimits: Ocean appears as long blurred parallel streaks rather than natural water variation; this does not break the sampled gameplay feedback but reduces visual coherence.
Wake continuity works, but repeated puffs are synthetic-looking.
Smoke opacity is better controlled; retain readable fire cores if changing it further.
No real-phone FPS or frame-pacing conclusions; no dense-motion scenario or contiguous video was provided.
